## Quoting edge cases

Commas inside quotes, escaped quotes, empty fields, and a field holding a newline.

```csv
name,note,qty
plain,no quoting needed,1
"comma, inside",still one field,2
"quote "" inside",doubled quote escapes it,3
empty next,,4
"multi
line",a field containing a newline,5
trailing spaces ,  leading spaces,6
```
